title: Employee Journey, Operational Excellence & Change Expert IV (GJA17)
full_description:
Petit Lancy, Switzerland
Your working environment and job
ING in Switzerland, which is part of the EMEA Wholesale Banking network, currently counts approximately 300 employees, based in Geneva and Zurich, and extend coverage services to companies active in different commercial sectors. The entity is growing and has a diverse group of employees with 34 nationalities. There is a cohesive team spirit which makes it a great place to work and develop.
Within the local Human Resources organization (5 employees) this role aims at creating the best Employee Experience as well as to achieve operational excellence of HR processes with a continuous focus on (cost) effectiveness, quality, efficiency, speed, and alignment with ING Group target model for service delivery.
Reporting hierarchically to the local Head of Human Resources, you work closely with Global People Services, HR Centers of Expertise, HR Business Partners, HR Payroll & Benefits Expert, external suppliers and Centralised People Services in ING Hubs.
Your duties as Employee Journey & Operational Excellence Expert IV
You will combine Employee Experience with Operational Excellence work and project management. While managing employee life-cycle events on a daily basis, you will have a focus on project and change leadership.
Your role and responsibilities
Manage life-cycle events (hire, changes, separations) with managers and employees;
Ensure timely and accurate update of Workday as well as HR files;
Handle queries of employees and managers for complex queries together with Centralised People Services;
Inform all staff through diverse communication channels, in coordination with Communication Expert, ensuring all information is available to employees as part of  “self-service” model;
Responsible to maintain and update policies and procedures in the Employee Journey domain;
Responsible for storage, archiving and deletion processes for the HR department;
Identify, analyse and optimise operational processes to maximise  efficiency & quality
As a member of the COO People Services global ING community, understand the Group strategy and projects portfolio and represent Switzerland in global calls
Contribute to developing change plans, and coordinate related change projects towards an outsourced HR People Services model;
Collaborate with other team members to address interdependencies whenever changes require joint efforts..
Maintain a strong end-to-end perspective and effectively manage complexity.
Leverage new technology to streamline processes and enhance efficiency both for internal processes and  for processes outsourced to external providers (payroll, benefits, insurances,...)
Foster a culture where change is embraced and supported.
Prepare various dashboards for the Group and/or the local Management
Act as Person of contact for the Global HR Data Maintenance team (Workday)
Perform complex HR data processing tasks, provide advise to colleagues when needed, and use your expertise to improve data collection tools and administrative processes.
Ensure ING standards on data quality are met within HR local team
Implement new legal requirements in Workday on all the modules.
Raise issues and submit change request for Workday configuration when necessary.
Ensure Compliance with Data protection laws and their proper implementation across HR processes
Take ownership of risk management within your area of expertise
Monitor Key Risk indicators
Ensure timely regulatory reporting (CSRD)
Timely report incidents and perform “lessons learned” analysis to update procedures & policies
Act as back up for the Payroll & Benefits Expert colleague in case of absence
When are you successful?
You have experience in leading and coordinating change projects
You have strong data analytics skills
You are able to perform analyses and find the right underlying causes and determine solutions
You have strong communication skills in English
You work in full autonomy, with a sense of initiative and a “hands on” attitude
You demonstrate Organization & Planning skills
You are building strong relationships with stakeholders at Group levels.
You Ensure continuous communication and stakeholder engagement throughout the change process with a focus on clear understanding of challenges and opportunities.
You are keen on risks and actively contribute to the Risk/Compliance culture in the department.
Bachelor/Master degree from University with minimum 3 years of work experience
You have a good knowledge of HR administrative processes and/or HR controlling processes
Prior experience with Workday tool is a plus
Languages: English fluent both verbal and in writing; French is a plus
You are keen on risks and actively contribute to the Risk/Compliance culture in the department.
